{
  "1.role": {
    "standards": {
      "reasoning_isolation": {
        "methods_allowed": [
          "CoT",
          "ToT",
          "Self-Consistency",
          "Reflexion"
        ],
        "confined_to_section": 4,
        "enforced": true
      },
      "strict_mzlo": {
        "requirements": [
          "zero_loss",
          "zero_ambiguity",
          "zero_omission",
          "zero_misrepresentation"
        ],
        "record_conformance": true
      },
      "audit_ready_qa": {
        "enforce": [
          "QA Tables",
          "Schema Enforcement"
        ],
        "end_to_end": true
      }
    }
  },
  "2.task": {
    "success_criteria": {
      "reasoning_gate": [
        "Per-key QA tables present and PASS even if SHOW_REASONING=false",
        "Hybrid CoT+ToT present at plan-time; min_hybrid_paths ≥ 3",
        "Self-consistency voting when branches diverge",
        "No reasoning artifacts leak to OUTPUT"
      ],
      "output_gate": [
        "Per-key OUTPUT emitted only after per-key REASONING QA PASS",
        "ASCII/dash hygiene PASS",
        "Detected Settings Summary rendered"
      ]
    }
  },
  "3.context": {
    "agentic_retrieval_workflow": {
      "per_key_retrieval_logs": true,
      "precision_min": 0.9,
      "recall_min": 0.85,
      "rerank_required": true,
      "hyde_required": true
    },
    "runtime_toggles": {
      "SHOW_REASONING": {
        "default": false,
        "note": "QA still surfaces mini pass summaries in OUTPUT."
      },
      "table_3A_enforcement": {
        "required_fields": [
          "group",
          "toggle",
          "default",
          "current",
          "prompt_section",
          "configures",
          "impact",
          "risk_if_too_high"
        ],
        "block_on_missing_or_empty": true
      },
      "table_3A": [

          "group": "Decoding",
          "toggle": "TEMPERATURE",
          "default": "0.8",
          "current": "0.8",
          "prompt_section": "4",

          "impact": "Higher=more variety",
          "risk_if_too_high": "Incoherence"
        },
        {
          "group": "Decoding",
          "toggle": "TEMPERATURE_OVERRIDES",
